note: What the system believes, how sure it is, and what would prove it wrong (ATLAS input). The Learner checks every 'check' against the live record each evening.

beliefs.belief: VANTAGE's edge is WHICH stocks it picks
beliefs.evidence: luck_check2.json: beats random stocks/days in 100% of 200 worlds, every period
beliefs.wrong_if: after 30+ closed live VANTAGE tips, fewer than half beat NIFTY over the same days

beliefs.belief: Buying at 3:20 pm beats buying the next morning
beliefs.wrong_if: after 30+ live VANTAGE tips, the next morning's open is on average BELOW the 3:20 pm price (waiting would have been cheaper)

beliefs.belief: ADD MORE adds a small edge
beliefs.wrong_if: after 10+ live add-ons, tips with ADD MORE do no better than tips without

beliefs.belief: Tips just before results earn about half -> half quantity
beliefs.wrong_if: after 20+ live results-week tips, they do as well as the others

beliefs.belief: Panic days (falling, jumpy, weak breadth) give the best VANTAGE tips
beliefs.evidence: situation_memory: best in both periods, small samples
beliefs.wrong_if: after 10+ live panic-day tips, they average below the other tips

beliefs.belief: Thin stocks (< Rs 2 cr/day) give weaker tips
beliefs.level: contested (round 23: at account level the floor is not better; after +1% thin-stock costs about equal in the holdout, smaller fall without it)
beliefs.evidence: IMPROVE_RESULTS U (per trade); IMPROVE23_RESULTS.md (account level: fragile)
beliefs.wrong_if: after 20+ rejected thin signals, they average better than sent tips
after 10+ blocked repeats, they average clearly better than sent tips

beliefs.belief: Live VANTAGE tips will match the 13-year profile per type
beliefs.wrong_if: the Learner's expectation check says 'below expected' for any type

beliefs.belief: 'Gave back a profit' is the price of letting winners run
beliefs.wrong_if: a NEW exit idea cuts it without cutting yearly growth
a new market signal passes development + holdout + year-by-year

beliefs.belief: Timing inside the chosen stocks adds little in recent years
beliefs.wrong_if: timing-rule tests start passing again on new data

beliefs.belief: VANTAGE's choice is mostly 'strong, near-high stocks'; its own rules add about 0.75 points a trade on top
beliefs.evidence: random stocks with the same fingerprint earn +3.3% / +2.1% vs VANTAGE +4.1% / +2.9%; VANTAGE beats them in 98-100% of worlds
beliefs.wrong_if: a simple fingerprint pick matches VANTAGE in live tracking

unknowns: Every strategy uses only daily price and volume: no intraday structure, order book, or option-market data per stock has been tested as a stock-choice signal.
All strategies buy only (no shorting): in falling markets the system can only wait.
All tests assume fills at the open or close price: real 3:20 pm and 9:15 am fills are unmeasured (Kite 5-minute archive needed).
Results dates exist for only 506 companies: event effects for the rest are invisible.
The holdout (Nov 2023+) was a strong small/mid-cap rally: every 'recent' conclusion may be specific to that market.
Stock choice is VANTAGE's edge, but nobody knows yet WHICH part of the choice carries it (backlog 13a).
Every 'worst fall' in the tests is measured when trades close; the fall at daily prices is deeper (round 24: a 10% market gap costs about 15% in one morning, the stops cannot help).
